top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Pare Losses After Chip Rout, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks trimmed their losses heading into the European session, offering global investors some respite after the artificial intelligence trade stayed on the back foot and investors sought safety in bonds. Crude oil extended its gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
